name: נִינְוֵה
summary: Nineveh is the first of the cities built in Genesis 10:11, with Rehoboth-Ir and Calah. The verse gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: אֶת נִינְוֵה introduces Nineveh as the first place named after וַיִּבֶן, “and he built.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `niyneweeh` (old root key נינוה).
